announcements.headline: Q3 2026 Financial Results and Trading Update
announcements.insight: MWE reports Q3 2026 results following July contract wins. The September suspension of share repurchases suggests a shift in capital allocation strategy.

announcements.headline: Suspension of Share Repurchase Programme
announcements.insight: The suspension of the share repurchase programme follows recent contract wins. Shareholders should monitor future capital allocation decisions.

announcements.headline: Multiple Contract Wins Worth c. US$4m
announcements.insight: Multiple contract wins worth c. US$4m are reported. This follows an AGM and AIM rule change in June 2026.
